info.desc: With this bold and distinct album Matthew Good Band have established their calling cards. They include lyrics that openly ravage society's current focus of materialism, dead end spirituality and other immoral but obvious societal ills, a tight hard rocking sound, and pained vocals. This album is not just a showcase to what the band can do well, rock out with the best of them, but also what the band thinks and feels deeply about. lists.name: Juno Awards: Album of the Year

podcast.body: Released on September 14, 1999, this album contained major hits like `Load Me Up`, `Hello Time Bomb`, and `Strange Days`. Despite its high success, its potential for even greater achievement was hampered by significant internal band dysfunction and Matthew Good's principled refusal to engage in what he perceived as "games" within the American music industry, which affected its U.S. release. "Beautiful midnight came out on September 14, 1999, and it was loaded with it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
